title: The coefficient colimit above a fixed finite subextension in module sheaves
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $E$ be a finite intermediate extension $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\Omega$ [det-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed-subextensions]. Let $X$ be any scheme. Use a small skeleton of $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ and a coefficient universe containing the site, the coefficients and the set of finite intermediate fields [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Write $R=E_X=p_X^*\underline E$ and $B=\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}=p_X^*\underline\Omega$ for the pulled-back coefficient rings [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], viewed as section-ring sheaves by [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Let $I_E$ be the poset of finite intermediate extensions $F$ with $E\subseteq F\subseteq\Omega$, ordered by inclusion. For $F\subseteq G$ its diagram has transition $F_X\to G_X$ from [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map]. For $F\in I_E$ let $q_F:F_X\to B$ be the coefficient map of [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map] for $F$. Give $F_X$ and $B$ the $R$-actions induced by $E_X\to F_X$ [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map] and by $q_E:E_X\to B$. Then $I_E$ is nonempty and directed, and the maps $q_F$ exhibit $B$ as the colimit of this diagram in the category of sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. In particular its colimit comparison uses these maps $q_F$, not an unspecified isomorphism of the colimit objects.

proof.text: Write $I$ for all finite intermediate fields of $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. By [det-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed-subextensions], every finite compositum is finite. The field $E$ belongs to $I_E$, and for $F,G\in I_E$ the compositum $FG$ belongs to $I_E$ and contains both. Thus $I_E$ is nonempty and directed. For every $H\in I$, the finite compositum $EH$ is an object of $I_E$ containing $H$. All these fields form a set in the coefficient universe fixed in the statement, so both indexing posets are small.

source.place: First sentence: the filtered poset of finite extensions containing E.

proof.text: Put $a_{H,K}:H_X\to K_X$ for an inclusion $H\subseteq K$. These maps are the functorial images of subfield inclusions by [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map] and [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], so $a_{H,H}=1$ and $a_{K,L}a_{H,K}=a_{H,L}$. By [lem-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map-comp], $q_Ka_{H,K}=q_H$. In particular for $F\in I_E$, put $s_F=a_{E,F}$; then $a_{F,G}s_F=s_G$ and $q_Fs_F=q_E$. These are equalities of unital commutative ring-sheaf maps: [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] reconstructs the section rings and preserves the underlying sheaves identically. For a local scalar $r$ and section $x$, multiplicativity gives $a_{F,G}(s_F(r)x)=s_G(r)a_{F,G}(x)$ and $q_F(s_F(r)x)=q_E(r)q_F(x)$. Hence the transitions and the specified legs are $R$-linear for exactly the actions in the statement.

source.place: First sentence: compatibility with the E_X-module structures.

proof.text: The last isomorphism in [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x] identifies $B$, with its inclusion maps $q_H$ for $H\in I$, as a colimit in commutative ring sheaves. We verify the same universal property after restriction to $I_E$, rather than choosing a new isomorphism. Let $t_F:F_X\to A$ be a ring-sheaf cocone on $I_E$. For $H\in I$ define $\widetilde t_H=t_{EH}a_{H,EH}$. If $H\subseteq K$, then $EH\subseteq EK$; the cocone equation and composition from step 2 give $\widetilde t_Ka_{H,K}=t_{EK}a_{H,EK}=t_{EH}a_{H,EH}=\widetilde t_H$. Thus this is a cocone on $I$. The full colimit gives a unique ring-sheaf map $t:B\to A$ with $tq_H=\widetilde t_H$. For $F\in I_E$, $EF=F$ and hence $tq_F=t_F$. Conversely any map $u:B\to A$ with $uq_F=t_F$ on $I_E$ satisfies $uq_H=uq_{EH}a_{H,EH}=t_{EH}a_{H,EH}$ for every $H$, and full-colimit uniqueness gives $u=t$. This proves the tail colimit with the original $q_F$, by the definition in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: First sentence: restricting the coefficient colimit to F containing E, with its given cocone.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-directed-ring-sheaf-module-colimit] on the chosen small pro-etale site, with $R=E_X$, $I=I_E$, $A_F=F_X$, $A=B$, $s_F=a_{E,F}$ and $s=q_E$. Step 1 checks the small nonempty directed index; step 2 checks compatibility of all scalar maps and legs as unital ring-sheaf maps; step 3 supplies the required commutative-ring-sheaf colimit. The lemma therefore makes $B$ a colimit in sheaves of $R$-modules with the very same maps $q_F$. Its explicit uniqueness assertion says that every compatible family of $R$-linear maps $F_X\to M$ factors uniquely through these $q_F$. Consequently the comparison from any chosen module colimit to $B$ is the map characterized by these legs, as required.

source.place: First sentence: passage from the ring-sheaf cocone to the E_X-module colimit.
